content.text: March 28, 2026Updated March 29, 2026, 7:35 p.m. ETNo. 3 Illinois defeated No. 9 Iowa to advance to the men's NCAA Tournament Final Four.This marks the Fighting Illini's first appearance in the Final Four since 2005.Illinois will play UConn on Saturday, April 4 in Indianapolis.Tickets for the Final Four game are currently available for purchase.20 years later, Illinois is back in the Final Four.No. 3 Illinois defeated No. 9 Iowa on Saturday evening in Houston, advancing to the Final Four in the men's NCAA Tournament.The Fighting Illini took down a Big Ten rival in the Hawkeyes, ending their Cinderella run in the Elite Eight 71-59. This is Illinois' first trip to the Final Four since 2005.Shop Illinois Final Four ticketsIt was a close game throughout, but Illinois top scorers Keaton Wagler and Andrej Stojakovic were too much for for Iowa down the stretch.Now, Illinois awaits their Final Four opponent, No. 2 UConn.
